// say what it means for them in the PR.

export declare const ADOPTION_OUTCOMES: readonly ["created", "reused", "modified"];

export declare const ADOPTION_REVISION_SCHEMA: {
    readonly oneOf: readonly [{
        readonly type: "string";
        readonly pattern: "\\S";
    }, {
        readonly type: "integer";
        readonly minimum: 1;
        readonly maximum: number;
    }];
};

export type AdoptionOutcome = (typeof ADOPTION_OUTCOMES)[number];

export type AdoptionRevision = string | number;

export interface AdoptsDeclaration {
    type: string;
    title: TextRef;
    schema: SandboxSchema;
    adopt: OwnerActionReference;
    read: OwnerActionReference;
    revert?: OwnerActionReference;
}

export declare const BLUEPRINT_LIMITS: {
    readonly parts: 128;
    readonly steps: 128;
};

export declare const BLUEPRINT_PART_ORIGIN_SCHEMA: {
    readonly type: "object";
    readonly properties: {
        readonly source: {
            readonly oneOf: readonly [{
                readonly type: "object";
                readonly properties: {
                    readonly kind: {
                        readonly const: "package";
                    };
                    readonly plugin_id: {
                        readonly type: "string";
                        readonly minLength: 1;
                    };
                    readonly version: {
                        readonly type: "string";
                        readonly minLength: 1;
                    };
                };
                readonly required: readonly ("kind" | "version" | "plugin_id")[];
                readonly additionalProperties: false;
            }, {
                readonly type: "object";
                readonly properties: {
                    readonly kind: {
                        readonly const: "draft";
                    };
                    readonly draft_id: {
                        readonly type: "string";
                        readonly minLength: 1;
                    };
                    readonly revision: {
                        readonly type: "integer";
                        readonly minimum: 1;
                        readonly maximum: number;
                    };
                };
                readonly required: readonly ("kind" | "revision" | "draft_id")[];
                readonly additionalProperties: false;
            }];
        };
        readonly part_id: {
            readonly type: "string";
            readonly minLength: 1;
        };
    };
    readonly required: readonly ("source" | "part_id")[];
    readonly additionalProperties: false;
};

    readonly oneOf: readonly [{
        readonly type: "object";
        readonly properties: {
            readonly kind: {
                readonly const: "package";
            };
            readonly plugin_id: {
                readonly type: "string";
                readonly minLength: 1;
            };
            readonly version: {
                readonly type: "string";
                readonly minLength: 1;
            };
        };
        readonly required: readonly ("kind" | "version" | "plugin_id")[];
        readonly additionalProperties: false;
    }, {
        readonly type: "object";
        readonly properties: {
            readonly kind: {
                readonly const: "draft";
            };
            readonly draft_id: {
                readonly type: "string";
                readonly minLength: 1;
            };
            readonly revision: {
                readonly type: "integer";
                readonly minimum: 1;
                readonly maximum: number;
            };
        };
        readonly required: readonly ("kind" | "revision" | "draft_id")[];
        readonly additionalProperties: false;
    }];
};

export interface Blueprint {
    title: TextRef;
    parts: BlueprintPart[];
    purpose: {
        audience: TextRef;
        work: TextRef;
        inputs: TextRef;
        outputs: TextRef;
        first_result: TextRef;
    };
    steps: Array<{
        step_id: string;
        title: TextRef;
        part_ids: string[];
    }>;
    example_task: {
        title: TextRef;
        input: TextRef;
        step_ids: string[];
        result: {
            part_id: string;
            location: TextRef;
        };
    };
}

export interface BlueprintPart {
    part_id: string;
    required: boolean;
    layer: SettingLayer;
    proposal: BlueprintProposal;
}

export type BlueprintPartOrigin = {
    source: BlueprintSource;
    part_id: string;
};

export type BlueprintProposal = {
    kind: "capability";
    requires: PluginRequirementDeclaration;
} | {
    kind: "skill";
    skill: {
        pack: string;
        skill_id: string;
    };
    state: "auto" | "manual";
} | {
    kind: "role";
    template: RoleTemplate;
} | {
    kind: "setting";
    key: string;
    value: SandboxJson;
} | {
    kind: "connection";
    category: string;
    purpose: TextRef;
} | {
    kind: "content";
    type: string;
    body: SandboxJson;
};

export type BlueprintSource = {
    kind: "package";
    plugin_id: string;
    version: string;
} | {
    kind: "draft";
    draft_id: string;
    revision: number;
};

export declare const CONTENT_ADOPTION_RESULT_SCHEMA: {
    readonly type: "object";
    readonly properties: {
        readonly outcome: {
            readonly enum: readonly ["created", "reused", "modified"];
        };
        readonly subject: {
            readonly type: "object";
            readonly properties: {
                readonly kind: {
                    readonly type: "string";
                    readonly minLength: 1;
                };
                readonly id: {
                    readonly type: "string";
                    readonly minLength: 1;
                };
            };
            readonly required: readonly ["kind", "id"];
            readonly additionalProperties: false;
        };
        readonly revision: {
            readonly oneOf: readonly [{
                readonly type: "string";
                readonly pattern: "\\S";
            }, {
                readonly type: "integer";
                readonly minimum: 1;
                readonly maximum: number;
            }];
        };
    };
    readonly required: readonly ("subject" | "revision" | "outcome")[];
    readonly additionalProperties: false;
};

export declare const CONTENT_ADOPTION_REVERT_INPUT_SCHEMA: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>;

export declare const CONTENT_ADOPTION_REVERT_RESULT_SCHEMA: {
    readonly type: "object";
    readonly properties: {
        readonly outcome: {
            readonly enum: readonly ["restored", "detached"];
        };
        readonly subject: {
            readonly type: "object";
            readonly properties: {
                readonly kind: {
                    readonly type: "string";
                    readonly minLength: 1;
                };
                readonly id: {
                    readonly type: "string";
                    readonly minLength: 1;
                };
            };
            readonly required: readonly ["kind", "id"];
            readonly additionalProperties: false;
        };
        readonly revision: {
            readonly oneOf: readonly [{
                readonly type: "string";
                readonly pattern: "\\S";
            }, {
                readonly type: "integer";
                readonly minimum: 1;
                readonly maximum: number;
            }];
        };
    };
    readonly required: readonly ("subject" | "revision" | "outcome")[];
    readonly additionalProperties: false;
};

export type ContentAdoptionCurrent<TValue = SandboxJson> = {
    state: "present";
    value: TValue;
    revision: AdoptionRevision;
    origin: BlueprintPartOrigin | null;
} | {
    state: "missing";
} | {
    state: "unavailable";
    reason: string;
};

export interface ContentAdoptionInput<Body = SandboxJson> {
    request_id: string;
    blueprint: BlueprintPartOrigin;
    selection: ContentAdoptionSelection;
    body: Body;
}

export type ContentAdoptionQuery<Body = SandboxJson> = {
    by: "proposal";
    type: string;
    blueprint: BlueprintPartOrigin;
    body: Body;
} | {
    by: "subject";
    subject: ActionSubject;
} | {
    by: "request";
    operation: "adopt" | "revert";
    request_id: string;
};

export interface ContentAdoptionReadInput<Body = SandboxJson> {
    queries: ContentAdoptionQuery<Body>[];
}

export interface ContentAdoptionReadOutput<TValue = SandboxJson> {
    results: ContentAdoptionReadResult<TValue>[];
}

export type ContentAdoptionReadResult<TValue = SandboxJson> = {
    kind: "proposal";
    candidates: Array<{
        subject: ActionSubject;
        current: ContentAdoptionCurrent<TValue>;
    }>;
} | {
    kind: "subject";
    current: ContentAdoptionCurrent<TValue>;
} | {
    kind: "receipt";
    operation: "adopt";
    request_id: string;
    receipt: ContentAdoptionResult;
    current: ContentAdoptionCurrent<TValue>;
} | {
    kind: "receipt";
    operation: "revert";
    request_id: string;
    receipt: ContentAdoptionRevertResult;
    current: ContentAdoptionCurrent<TValue>;
} | {
    kind: "missing";
    operation: "adopt" | "revert";
    request_id: string;
};

export interface ContentAdoptionResult {
    outcome: AdoptionOutcome;
    subject: ActionSubject;
    revision: AdoptionRevision;
}

export interface ContentAdoptionRevertInput {
    adopt_request_id: string;
    request_id: string;
    subject: ActionSubject;
    expected_revision: AdoptionRevision;
}

export interface ContentAdoptionRevertResult {
    outcome: "restored" | "detached";
    subject: ActionSubject;
    revision: AdoptionRevision;
}

export type ContentAdoptionSelection = {
    kind: "create";
} | {
    kind: "reuse" | "update";
    subject: ActionSubject;
    expected_revision: AdoptionRevision;
};

export declare function contentAdoptionInputSchema(body: SandboxSchema): ActionSchema;

export declare function contentAdoptionReadInputSchema(body: SandboxSchema, extraQueries?: readonly ActionSchema[]): ActionSchema;

export declare function contentAdoptionReadOutputSchema(extraResults?: readonly ActionSchema[]): ActionSchema;

// Declarations the exports above refer to, which no entry exports itself:

type OwnerActionReference = Pick<ActionReference, "capability_id" | "version">;
